messages:
Maya: Quick team update — we officially crossed $5M ARR and 30M monthly requests today 🎉🎉 Thank you all, this is huge.
Sanjay: omg amazing!!! :tada: :raised_hands:
Priya: WOOHOO!!! OK catering debate: taco truck or sushi boat? also remote folks get gift cards. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Alex: Taco truck > sushi boat. also can we rent one of those tiny parade horns? 😂
Jamie: Please no tiny parade horns near the server room. remember the 'beepathon' incident :grimacing:
Nora: Hybrid plan proposal: in-person tacos Tues 12pm in courtyard + virtual happy hour 5pm PT with $25 DoorDash for remote folks. Works?
Maya: Love that. @Nora can you check with facilities on courtyard permits & waste pickup? Ops, budget ok?
ops-bot: Facilities check: courtyard reserved 12:00-13:30 Tue. Catering approval needed. Budget alert: must stay within Q2 recognition cap. @Nora please confirm vendor and estimate.
Nora: On it — pinging vendor list now, will file catering request and budget estimate in #events.
Sanjay: also massive shoutout to infra team — reduced tail latency 12% this quarter which kept conversion steady during the spike. huge engineering win 👏
Alex: Marketing: can we get a social-friendly shot? no numbers, just team hype + a fun GIF. I'll coordinate with Priya for behind-the-scenes footage.
Priya: I'll stitch a 15s reel. Send me pics to #marketing-assets or DM.
Jamie: Idea: tiny celebratory item — like a company surfboard trophy (not actually surfed) or ridiculous hats. who wants to sign it?
Maya: Poll time — react to this thread: :thumbsup: for Tue lunch, :thumbsdown: for Wed, :ok_hand: for remote-only. I'll finalize based on reactions by EOD.
Sanjay: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Alex: :ok_hand: (I'll be remote but will join virtual happy hour)
Nora: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar invite created for Tue 12:00 PT (tentative) and virtual happy hour at 17:00 PT. See #events for details and RSVP links.
Maya: Perfect. Thank you team — I'll bring sparkling cider and an excessively large 'congrats' banner. Tiny parade horns optional. :tada: :sparkles:
